## Description

Combines genetic evolutionary algorithms with multi-agent reinforcement learning policy search to evolve robust portfolio allocation weights across volatile economic regimes.

## Where it may fit

Multi-asset tactical allocation, regime-shifting economic cycles, multi-objective portfolio optimization.

## Vehicles

Quantitative Asset Management Funds, Multi-Strategy Hedge Funds.

## Required data

Multi-asset historical return panels, macroeconomic leading indicators, risk tolerance parameters.

## Caveats

Evolutionary search optimization requires substantial compute time across generational population runs.
